_about: Issue #628. The reviewed part of the log-shipping privacy policy; tools/grafana/kit.py adds what it finds in code. Every entry says why. Rows here must exist in code or in pending-rows.json (kit.py --check).

exclude_rows.ACCOUNT_LOGIN: free text with the account name and the IP address
exclude_rows.HOST_PASSWORD: free text with the account name and the IP address
exclude_rows.CLIENT_HANDSHAKE: addr= is the client's network address
exclude_rows.UPNP_MAPPING: the PC's router and port mappings

name_free_rows.FORK_BUILD: build name, commit and server switches only (ForkBuildInfo.Describe); name= is the build's name
name_free_rows.BG_POPULATION: #625 rule: no player or account names; counts and kinds only (LivingRows.cs)
name_free_rows.CAST_INTERRUPT: #625 rule: caster= and attacker= are kinds (LivingRows.Kind), never names
name_free_rows.CC_BREAK: #625 rule: target=, breaker= and caster= are kinds (LivingRows.Kind)
name_free_rows.BG_TARGET_PICK: #625 rule: target= is a pick kind (LivingRows.PickKind)
name_free_rows.PLAYER_LINE_OUTCOME: #625 rule: channel, intent and counts; never the line's text or a name

CHAT_LINE.to: a tell's player or a guild line's guild (BotChatTranscript.Player/Bot)

CHAT_EMOTE.from: the emoting bot's or player's name

SERVER_HEAP_SNAPSHOT.tool: a file path under the user's profile folder (C:\Users\<name>\.dotnet\tools)
SERVER_HEAP_SNAPSHOT.command: holds the tool and output file paths
SERVER_HEAP_SNAPSHOT.stdout: dotnet-gcdump's own output: free text with the output file's full path
SERVER_HEAP_SNAPSHOT.stderr: dotnet-gcdump's own output: free text, exception messages with paths
SERVER_HEAP_SNAPSHOT.stdoutKeyLines: the tool's error and timeout lines: free text, exception messages with paths
SERVER_HEAP_SNAPSHOT.stderrKeyLines: the tool's error and timeout lines: free text, exception messages with paths

CHAT_LINE.who: the speaker's kind, player or bot (a literal in BotChatTranscript)

AUTONOMOUS_KILL_XP.sameName: a count of kills of the same monster name (AutonomousKillXpDiagnostics: int?)

AUTONOMOUS_GROUP_RESURRECTION_TIMEOUT.role: the dead member's group role (BotPveGroupRole), not a name

SERVER_BOT_FIELD_CENSUS.grew: server field names and averages (ServerMemoryDiagnostics), no people
SERVER_BOT_FIELD_CENSUS.largest: server field names and averages (ServerMemoryDiagnostics), no people

SERVER_STATIC_CENSUS.grew: static collection names and counts (ServerMemoryDiagnostics), no people
SERVER_STATIC_CENSUS.largest: static collection names and counts (ServerMemoryDiagnostics), no people

frequency.AUTONOMOUS_ROUTE_BLOCK: one when a spot turns into a shared route block (3 different solo gamebots gave a camp up there within 30 minutes; #570)
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_ROUTE_BLOCK_AVOID: one per solo gamebot camp pick that skipped camps at or past a shared route block while another camp was left (#570)
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_NEAR_MISS_DEAD_END: one when a gamebot first stalls at a new near-miss dead end (a partial path ending within 256 of its target; #570)
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_NEAR_MISS_ROAD_RECOVERY: one per first stall at a near-miss dead end whose zone roads have a way to the target (#570)
frequency.RVR_FORCE_BATTLEGROUP: one per battlegroup change (formed, joined, left, ended), at most one per group per 10 s pulse (#599)
frequency.BG_MUSTER_PARTY: one per autonomous gamebot party formed or joined at a battleground wave's muster, at most every 10 s per realm and keep (#530 step 5b)
frequency.COMPANION_RVR_ENGAGE: change-only: one per player's group each time its own pick in the frontier, battlegrounds or Darkness Falls changes call (engage or hold) or target
frequency.DRAGON_RALLY_ROUTE_RETRY: one per failed plan of a raider's safe route to an open-world boss rally: at most one per raider every 30 seconds while the plans fail (#767)
frequency.DRAGON_RALLY_FALLBACK: one per raider per spot after three failed rally plans from it: the walk past a neutral boss, or the keep-safe-route note for an aggressive one (#767)
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_RALLY_STUCK: one per open-world rally member that stood still off the staging ring for 15 minutes after the departure, then sent to its capital (#767)
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_GROUP_DANGER_RETREAT: one per gamebot PvE party that leaves a place after losing members to monsters far above it (#569)
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_GROUP_CAMP_BUDGET: one per PvE party camp pick whose candidate list the travel budget cut (none when every camp fit; #569)
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_GROUP_PULL_STALL: one per stall of a grinding gamebot party (6 minutes with no fight or experience; #569)
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_GROUP_PULL_STALL_END: one at the end of a stall that reaches 11 minutes, when the party's task ends (#569)
frequency.PLAYER_KEEP_DEFENSE_SIZED: one per player keep attack when its first alarm rallies the bot defense, then one each time the defense grows a tier (#523)
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_PARTY_KILL_TARGET: once per new kill target per party (#569 step 6)
frequency.COMPANION_PATH_DF: at most one per player-led bot per 30 s, in Darkness Falls (#571 step 3)
frequency.COMPANION_LEVEL_SYNC: one per /spawn helper each time its owner out-levels it, out of combat (#571 step 6)
frequency.COMPANION_LEADER_FOCUS: change-only: one per bot of a player's group each time it turns onto a new player's target over another choice, in the frontier, battlegrounds and Darkness Falls
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_KILL_XP: every 25th autonomous gamebot PvE kill, at most 120 a minute (bot_kill_xp_sample_every)
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_GOAL_ATTEMPT: one per finished gamebot goal attempt (detail.log)
frequency.SERVER_STALL: once a minute when a game-loop tick ran slow
frequency.AUTONOMOUS_ZONE_SEAM_CYCLE: one per seam reversal caught (#570: a gamebot's zone steps turned back twice over one border for one goal); rare, 2 on the owner's 11/23 log
frequency.RVR_RANKS: once an hour per realm, with RVR_HOUR (#528)
frequency.RVR_DECIDE: one per change of an RvR decision, within the RvR record's minute budget
frequency.RVR_CONTACT_SHADOW: once a minute per realm, when a fight board of that realm listed an enemy in the minute (#529)
frequency.RVR_CONTACT_UNKNOWN: at most 20 a minute per realm: the first listed-but-unknown listing of a group-enemy pair in the shadow's minute (#529)
frequency.RVR_CONTACT_SHADOW_FAILED: the shadow's first failure, then every 1,000th (warn; the board is still built) (#529)
frequency.CHAT_LINE: every chat line a player can see from bots, and every line the player says
